campaign: From a travel idea to a group chat
voiceDirection: Clear, engaging adult British female creator. Warm, energetic, trustworthy, comfortable conversational pace.

dialogues.text: Got a trip in mind? Find someone to share it with, on Tips to Trip.
Create a Travel Buddy post. Add your route, plan your days, and bring your itinerary to life with places and photos.
Choose your trip preferences, from budget and travel style to the kind of buddy you'd love to meet.
Your trip details bring the plan together. The stops, the photos, the preferences. All in one place.
Share your trip, and let the adventure find its people.
Manage your trips, review requests, and decide who joins. You're in control of your travel plans.
Then keep the conversation in the group chat. Share ideas, ask a question, and get ready to explore together.
Your next adventure starts with a connection. Download the Tips to Trip app now.
